training.algorithm: TorchRL MAPPO; shared actor, central critic, per-agent PPO ratios
training.initialization: random transport weights, empty Adam and fresh value statistics

notebook.scope: All research code cells, excluding initial installation; one actual 16,384-step CUDA MAPPO update and 2 evaluation cases. API verification, not convergence.

protocol_notes: Both upper policies were trained from random weights, fresh Adam and fresh value statistics; only the walking controller was pretrained.

Trial 01 used a 0.22m arrival tolerance, gamma=.99 and lambda=.98. Trial 02 used a 0.30m tolerance and the default time-scaled gamma=.990025, lambda=.9801; this is development, not a controlled single-factor ablation.

Deterministic evaluation starts from matching native seed states, seeds 98000 through 98015. Training used seed 42 and randomly rotated/jittered crossing states. No test-case actions were used for updates.
Training progress counts stochastic exploratory successes; evaluation uses mean policy actions.

Source files were still being developed during these screening trials; initial checkpoint and full configuration, settings, physics-asset hashes and final weight hashes are retained. The executable student flow snapshots sources before learning.
One training seed and a narrow crossing configuration family. Colab/T4 runtimes, multiple learning seeds and four-robot convergence have not been measured.
